critical_code_review_comments: Clients.jsx GroupedClients correctly filters empty categories via .filter(g => filter==='all' ? g.items.length>0 : g.value===filter) — clean.
OFFICE_OPTIONS and OFFICES are duplicated in Clients.jsx (lines 23-27 and 227-232) — minor DRY violation; consider exporting one canonical constant.
Students.jsx imports CLIENT_TYPES from /pages/Clients which is a fine module dependency, but a shared constants file (e.g., /lib/constants.js) would prevent the page→page coupling.

CategoryHeader uses label.replace(/\W+/g,'_').toLowerCase() as testid — happens to coincide with the value-based slug for current labels but is a fragile coupling. If a label ever changes (e.g., 'Sub Agent & Associate'), the testid becomes 'sub_agent_associate' still, but renaming is easier if testid uses the canonical value. Recommend passing `value` to CategoryHeader for the testid.
Students.jsx setForm in openAddStudent always seeds reference='' first, then pickClientAndEnrol overrides it on pick — guarantees no stale reference leaks between sessions. Good.

openAddStudent does NOT consult the ?staff= URL flow — the URL-based pre-fill (from OfficeDashboard add-admission) sets open=true directly via the useEffect at line 125-135, bypassing the picker entirely. This is intentional and correct (office_admin flow vs super_admin picker flow are separate).

client-picker-dialog rendered inside <header>: technically a Dialog is a portal so DOM-wise it lifts out, but having two sibling Dialogs (open + pickerOpen) inside a single <header> is unusual layout. Functional, no impact.
